title: Enouia Memory Windows workspace IPC v1
description: Typed envelopes between a Windows host page (Memory's reference workspace or Runtime's client, ADR-MEM-45) and the embedded Core (ADR-MEM-44). camelCase fields; logical IDs and single-use picker tokens only: no paths, SQL, shell text, or caller-asserted identity. Commands that can commit to the Vault carry an idempotency key; the others carry null. A response carries a result object or an error, never both; Rust (enouia-memory-contract::workspace) enforces the command-to-kind pairing; result fields are built by enouia-memory-workspace and are not constrained by this schema.
